caption: The drawing features two stylized birds facing each other, symmetrically perched on either side of a central tree or plant. The birds have bright yellow bodies, black and white eyes, black markings on their faces and legs, and predominantly white wings and tails with red outlines and accents. Both birds have red crests on their heads. The tree or plant they sit on has a light tan trunk and branches, adorned with red leaves. The background is a solid grayish-tan color, and the entire composition is framed by a lighter tan border. Above the drawing, large red and black text reads "FOLK ART OF RURAL PENNSYLVANIA," while below the illustration, there is smaller text in black and red that states, "SELECTED BY THE INDEX OF AMERICAN DESIGN PENNSYLVANIA ART PROJECT WORK PROJECTS ADMINISTRATION." The overall color palette consists of yellow, red, white, black, tan, and grayish-tan.
title: Study for Portfolio Cover: "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
